title: The Basket with One Cloth Napkin Too Few
youtube_title: The Basket with One Cloth Napkin Too Few | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Dori sees that a basket of buns and one napkin too few will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Dori makes a smaller, even share so Oren is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
